item.title: India, Algeria hold first joint defence commission meet
item.description: India and Algeria signed the Rules of Procedure to oversee defence cooperation between the two countries. Both sides signed the Rules of Procedure to oversee the implementation of India-Algeria defence cooperation, which will guide future joint commission engagements and streamline collaboration mechanisms between the two countries.
